sample_unit: patients with diabetic kidney disease who had a KidneyIntelX assay
unlisted_practices: Using ML-based risk stratification within a population health program with clinical pharmacists and patient coordinators to escalate SGLT2i/GLP-1 RA prescribing and specialist referral
Pre-post assessment of eGFR slope and A1C after deploying a prognostic risk test

screen.reason: This is a real-world prospective implementation study evaluating the clinical impact of deploying KidneyIntelX (an ML-based prognostic test) on clinician decision-making and patient outcomes, but it does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
